titulo.estudio: Les panneaux utiles : Observer les formes

intro: Recognize prohibitions, obligations and basic services in public places. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Recognize prohibitions, obligations and basic services in public places. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: on a sign, the imperative or « interdit » usually expresses a rule; the icon and the place give context. In this passage, «sortie» means «exit».
